# ABK Trading & Service

> Authorized Qatar distributor, importer, and retailer of automotive paint protection film (VTEK PPF), solar window film, German nano-ceramic coatings (Autotriz), 20L commercial wash chemicals (Briller), German foam pads (GrünesAuto), and detailing supplies in Mesaimeer, Doha, Qatar — plus fixed-price installed VTEK PPF packages fitted at a VTEK-authorised partner centre in Doha.

ABK Trading & Service (Google Business Profile: "ABK Trading and Service — Vertek & Autotriz") operates a retail showroom and wholesale warehouse at Showroom no. 2, Building 1306, Street 70, Zone 56, Mesaimeer, Doha, Qatar (GPS 25.2040478, 51.5029268; phone & WhatsApp +974 3083 8355; landline +974 4451 4476; email sales@abktradingservice.com). Opening hours: Saturday–Thursday 10:00 – 13:00 & 16:00 – 22:00; Friday Closed. Every page is published in English (`/en`) and Arabic (`/ar`).

ABK stocks 58 active SKUs across retail bottles, 20-litre workshop drums, and 1.52m × 15m master film rolls. Website cart orders receive automatic tiered discounts (10% off from QAR 500; 15% off from QAR 700) and free delivery across Doha, Lusail, Al Rayyan, Al Wakrah, and Al Khor from QAR 200 (QAR 25 below; showroom pickup free).

ABK is a product distributor and store, not a detailing workshop. The one installed service ABK sells is fixed-price VTEK Weather Armor PPF installation in Doha (PRO 10-yr: front-end QAR 899 / QAR 1,049 / QAR 1,199, full front QAR 1,599 / QAR 1,899 / QAR 2,199, full body QAR 3,999 / QAR 4,799 / QAR 5,499 for Sedan / Mid SUV / Large SUV; PRO PLUS 10-yr & MATTE 5-yr full body QAR 4,799 / QAR 5,699 / QAR 6,499; custom panels from QAR 500), backed by VTEK NFC e-Warranty registration and ABK's 12-month fitting guarantee. Window tint, ceramic coatings, and detailing chemicals are sold as products only.
